mapper.sql: select provider_id, provider_name, provider_type, base_url, api_key_enc, models, thinking_style, echo_reasoning, role_keys, user_ids, dept_ids, sort, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from itm_llm_provider
mapper.insert: insert into itm_llm_provider (provider_name, provider_type, base_url, api_key_enc, models, thinking_style, echo_reasoning, role_keys, user_ids, dept_ids, sort, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{providerName}, #{providerType}, #{baseUrl}, '', #{models}, ifnull(#{thinkingStyle}, 'none'), ifnull(#{echoReasoning}, '0'), ifnull(#{roleKeys}, ''), ifnull(#{userIds}, ''), ifnull(#{deptIds}, ''), ifnull(#{sort}, 0), ifnull(#{status}, '0'), ifnull(#{createBy}, ''), sysdate(), ifnull(#{remark}, ''))
mapper.update: update itm_llm_provider set api_key_enc = #{apiKeyEnc} where provider_id = #{providerId}
mapper.delete: delete from itm_llm_provider where provider_id in #{id}
